units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:8">Gitt. III, 8</cite> <he>בהוצאת ס׳</he> at budding time.

<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:7">Orl. I, 7</cite> <he>העלים</he> … <he>והס׳ מותרין וכ׳</he> Ms. M. the leaves, the sprouts, the sap of vines and the budding berries are permitted in the third year; <cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:7">ib.</cite> <he>הס׳ אסור וכ׳</he> the buds are forbidden, because they are fruits; Sifra K’dosh. ch. V, Par. 3 <he>מֵי ס׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 58b:17">B. Kam. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>המבכיר כרם … ס׳</he> he who cuts (the berries of) his neighbor’s vineyard in the budding stage.
